_comment: A profile is the answers you would otherwise retype into every script.json: which
backend renders, which voice reads, which palette, how much you are willing to spend.
Precedence, narrowest wins:  script.json  >  --flags  >  profile  >  .env  >  defaults.
A profile never overrides something the script states explicitly — the script is about
one video and knows more than a profile that covers all of them.
name: personal
description: One person, own channel. Free tools, no invoices, occasional videos.
_backend: html renders locally with Chrome + FFmpeg and costs nothing per video. api costs real money per second — see profiles/business.json.
_voice: omnivoice runs on your own machine, so there is no per-character bill and no API key. Set TTS_VOICE_ID in .env if you switch to a paid provider.
_theme: null = each template keeps its own palette. Put a theme-map.json key here to repaint every template the same way.
_brand: Fills the brand slots templates expose. Leave a field empty and the slot is dropped rather than filled with a placeholder — an empty string beats someone else's URL.
_costCeilingUsd: 0 = refuse anything that would be billed. The html backend never bills, so this ceiling only ever fires if you switch backend without meaning to. That is the point of it.
